It begins with a consultation

A consultation is the first step for every new client. It's a chance to talk through your concerns and get advice before you decide whether treatment is right for you.

Skin consultation

£100

What your consultation covers

  1. 01A conversation about your concerns and what you'd like to achieve
  2. 02A review of your medical history and any medicines you take
  3. 03An assessment of your face and skin
  4. 04Clear advice on suitable options, including their benefits, risks and alternatives
  5. 05A personalised treatment plan, with costs

Consultations for lines, wrinkles, jaw and sweating concerns

You can also book an aesthetics consultation to discuss:

  • Facial lines and wrinkles
  • The jaw and masseter (chewing muscle) area
  • Excessive underarm sweating

Any treatment for these concerns is only considered following a face-to-face consultation with a prescriber.

03Treatments

Treatments, tailored to you

The treatments below are available after a consultation, where Shirley will confirm whether they're suitable for you.

  • Dermal fillers

    A gel, usually made from hyaluronic acid (a substance found naturally in the skin), used to add or restore volume and to define features.

    Areas treated

    • Cheeks
    • Chin
    • Jawline
    • Lips
    • Marionette lines
    • Nasolabial lines
    • Temples

    From £250 per area

  • Skin boosters

    Small injections of hyaluronic acid into the skin to improve hydration and skin quality.

    From £240

  • Profhilo

    A hyaluronic acid skin treatment designed to improve hydration and the firmness of the skin. Shirley will advise how many sessions are right for you.

    From £250 per session

Prices are a guide. You'll receive a personalised treatment plan with costs at your consultation.

06FAQs

Frequently asked questions

Still have a question?

Call the clinic on 0141 564 1900 or email reception@berkeleyclinic.com, and reception will be happy to help.

Do I need a consultation first?

Yes. Your first appointment is a consultation, so Shirley can understand your concerns, review your medical history and advise on whether treatment is suitable for you.

How much does a consultation cost?

A skin consultation is £100 and an aesthetics consultation is £60. If you go ahead with treatment within [PLACEHOLDER: validity period], the fee is deducted from the cost of your treatment.

What forms will I need to complete?

When you book, you'll receive medical history and consent forms by email. Please complete them before your appointment so there's more time to talk at your consultation.

How long do dermal fillers last?

It varies from person to person, and depends on the product used, the area treated and how your body breaks the filler down. Shirley will explain what to expect for your treatment at your consultation.

Are there any risks or side effects?

All treatments carry some risk. Shirley will explain the possible side effects, risks and alternatives for any treatment she recommends, so you can make an informed decision.

What happens if I need to cancel?

Please let us know as soon as you can by calling the clinic on 0141 564 1900. [PLACEHOLDER: summary of the cancellation policy, matching the Policies section]

Is there a minimum age?

Yes. We do not offer any aesthetic treatments to anyone under 18.

Can I book by phone?

Yes. Call the clinic on 0141 564 1900 and reception will book you into Shirley's diary.
